result.title: Towards Data-Efficient, Real-Time World Models
result.comment: 18 pages, 12 figures, 1 table. Includes supplementary material
result.summary: State-of-the-art world models have been used to produce sequences of gameplay that accord with provided user-input actions. However, high quality, consistent gameplay generation often comes at the cost of inference speed, making real-time interactive play and ideation challenging. The substantial quantities of data used to train state-of-the-art models have also made custom training of these models appear impractical, limiting many of their potential uses in creative fields. In this work we demonstrate a major step towards efficient world models: achieving both fast high-quality inference, and improved data efficiency. This is done by replacing the next-token prediction paradigm with a two-stage discrete diffusion-based approach, introducing a lightweight refinement transformer which carries out iterative masked predictions. Building on an autoregressive world model capable of generating highly consistent and complex sequences over minutes (Kanervisto et al., 2025), we achieve substantial model speed-up (79x) with a modest quality trade-off. Additionally, we demonstrate that this model can be trained to reproduce high-quality, consistent gameplay using a dataset containing approximately one day (28 hours) of gameplay data. Our results demonstrate progress towards removing barriers to the use of world models in settings where real-time inference and data efficiency are essential.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向游戏画面世界模型，用两阶段离散扩散替代 next-token prediction：先粗生成，再由轻量 refinement transformer 做迭代掩码预测，从而在数据量约 28 小时的条件下实现约 79 倍推理加速并保持适度质量损失。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先粗后细的迭代掩码精化」与扩散式并行状态更新，可能为 LVR 中替代逐 token AR 的并行/迭代 latent 状态生成及迭代步数带来的计算成本权衡提供可核查线索，但该工作在像素级游戏序列上，与推理语义无直接联系。
